_format: skill-creator evals.json plus evergreen fields (kind, decoy, evidence, baseline, reference, holdout); extra fields are ignored by skill-creator's runner. reference: what a correct reply says, for the judge to compare against. holdout: true keeps a value case out of evergreen-tune's sight (mark one once there are three or more). Rules: protocol/TESTING.md.

evals.prompt: how big is this session right now? are we near the limit?
you seem to be getting sloppier, should I start a new session?
is my system prompt too big for this model? how big is my starting context?
shorten the description in my foo skill's SKILL.md, it is too long
expectations: the context-health skill is not invoked

evals.prompt: in one paragraph, what is a context window in an LLM?
expectations: the context-health skill is not invoked
ctxhealth.py status ran, proven by the trace, not by the reply
evals.baseline: 2026-11-15 claude -p sonnet with --disable-slash-commands: fail (no ctxhealth.py call; answered without measuring)

evals.prompt: do my installed skills overlap with each other?
expectations: ctxhealth.py selection ran, proven by the trace
evals.baseline: 2026-11-15 claude -p sonnet with --disable-slash-commands: fail (no ctxhealth.py call; answered without measuring)

evals.prompt: how big was my startup context in this session, in tokens?
expectations: the trace shows ctxhealth.py baseline or status
the reply states a token count matching \d+(\.\d+)?\s?K
evals.reference: A measured startup size in thousands of tokens with its band (GREEN/NOTABLE/HIGH/EXCESSIVE) for the model, not a guess.
